findings.finding: The Context cites two tests as the evidence that `severity_label` stays exercised after deleting `_sev`, but both line citations point to the wrong code: `tests/unit/test_review_kernel.py:72-76` is `test_pass3_decide_never_stamps_a_severity_key` (asserts `"severity" not in ...`, does NOT call `severity_label`) — the real exercise is `:65-69` (`test_severity_label_buckets`); and `tests/unit/test_divergence_grade_split.py:104` is `test_incomplete_enumeration_contributes_but_never_floors` which calls `impact_plan`, not `severity_label` — the real call is `:94`. The load-bearing premise (severity_label remains covered, so deleting `_sev` is safe) is verified TRUE at the corrected lines, but the stated cites are inaccurate despite 'Cites re-measured on ee5253abfd4'.
findings.location: Context / Problem — 'severity_label at :621 is already exercised by tests/unit/test_review_kernel.py:72-76 and tests/unit/test_divergence_grade_split.py:104'
